tmr.review:
TMR IS NOT RECOMMENDED
NOT FOR A/A-

BUS530- Tmr.
Tmr sir er teaching best. Atleast semester seshe bolte parben apni kichu shikchen.
Question pattern-- Quiz Mcq, True False and Fill in the blanks thake. Eta valo korar jonno full class lecture A-Z valo kore shunte hobe and note korte hobe.
Mid & Final-- Sir er note thekei ashe. But graphs thakle must eta perfectly draw korte hobe. Sir er question case based and ektu tricky hoy. So concept somporke valo idea thaaka must laghbe. Sir line to line pore. Marking strict ektu. And, if your answer is wrong, you will not get any type of partial marks.
Report & Presentation-- Sir group report er topic dibe. Sei topic valo kore likhte hobe. Sir hates Plagiarism and AI. Report e boro Parcentage e AI and Plagiarism pele ekta valo amount er marks deduct kore. Presentation niye pera dey na.
Grading : Fair. Final e ekta bonus question dey 3 marks er. Otai curve hishebe count hoy.

Tanvir Shakik Bhalo poray, questions o easy kore. Quiz ektu hard. And ektu boring. Fair grading kore. notes korba bhalo kore, and class miss dio na.
Ar questions o uni directly kore case na, so slides bhalo moto porlei hoy. Ar project er shuru theke unar feedback niba kibhabe ki korte hobe and all tahole project o bhalo hobe and tai marks o bhalo ashe.
I would say to avoid tmr. Takes too much effort to land on a decent grade. If my effort is medium, I should earn a medium grade. In tmr's case the scenerio is not such
